description:
The agent must: (1) Read the spec draft to identify 9 components. (2) Map shape presets (Blob→'30px 70px 70px 30px', Leaf→'0px 50px 0px 50px', Full pill→'9999px') using the proprietary preset table, not guesswork. (3) Apply clamping rules: negative -5px → 0px with a correction note; 10500px → 9999px cap. (4) Apply the exact Tailwind class logic: uniform 0→'rounded-none', uniform 9999→'rounded-full', other uniform→'rounded-[px]', mixed→'rounded-[px_px_
px_px]' (underscores, not spaces). (5) For the 1.5rem component, output the CSS with the rem value intact but OMIT the Tailwind arbitrary class (skill mandates omission for non-px units). Output all results into border_radius_reference.json.
